name: Pastel Defender Heliotrope
source:
This is the story of Heliotrope, an automaton who finds love and happiness amidst the horror wrought by the deranged Chartreuse.

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/pages/pasteldefenderheliotrope.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
这是天芥菜的故事，它是一个机器人，在疯狂的沙特尔制造的恐怖中找到了爱和幸福。

[来自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/pages/pasteldefenderheliotrope.html]宅男世界[/url]]
